body.p: This letter of intent ("LOI") sets out the principal terms on which {{fontara_entity}} ("Vendor"), proposes to provide services to **{{customer}}**, {{customer_entity}} with its principal place of business at {{customer_address}}, {{customer_city}}, {{customer_region}} {{customer_postal}} ("Customer"): {{engagement}}. The parties intend to record the engagement in a master services agreement and statement of work (together, the "Definitive Agreement").

This LOI describes the engagement the parties propose, under which Vendor would provide the services described in it to Customer, and the principal commercial terms on which they expect to agree. The description is illustrative and subject to the Definitive Agreement, and the parties shall negotiate in good faith with a view to signing the Definitive Agreement before this LOI expires.

The proposed fees are {{currency}}{{fees}} a year, invoiced annually in advance and payable {{payment_terms}}, for an initial term of {{initial_term}}. These fees, the payment structure and the key assumptions in this LOI are subject to confirmation in due diligence. Neither party may depart materially from them in the Definitive Agreement without the other's written consent.

then.p: For 60 days from the date of this LOI, Customer shall not solicit or negotiate proposals from other providers for the services described in it, although it may respond to approaches it did not solicit. Exclusivity ends early if the parties have not agreed the principal terms of the Definitive Agreement within 45 days.
Neither party is bound by any exclusivity obligation, and each may discuss similar arrangements with others.

body.p: Each party shall keep confidential the terms of this LOI and the information the other discloses in connection with the proposed engagement, and use that information only to evaluate it. This obligation continues for 2 years after this LOI ends, whether or not the parties sign the Definitive Agreement.

This LOI records the parties' present intentions and is not binding, except for its provisions on confidentiality, exclusivity and governing law, which bind the parties. Neither party is obliged to enter into the Definitive Agreement, and no contract is to be implied from this LOI or the parties' conduct.

This LOI takes effect on {{effective}} and expires on {{expiration}} unless the parties extend it in writing or sign the Definitive Agreement first. Its binding provisions survive its expiry for the periods they state, and otherwise neither party has any further obligation under it.
Each party bears its own costs in connection with this LOI and the negotiation of the Definitive Agreement.

then.p: This LOI is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute arising out of or relating to this LOI by good-faith negotiation between senior executives for 30 days. A dispute not resolved in that time shall be finally settled by binding arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association under its Commercial Arbitration Rules, before a single arbitrator, seated in San Francisco, California, and judgment on the award may be entered in any court of competent jurisdiction. Either party may seek injunctive relief from a court to protect its confidential information or intellectual property.

This LOI, and any non-contractual obligation arising out of or in connection with it, is governed by the law of England and Wales. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute arising out of or in connection with this LOI by good-faith negotiation between senior executives for 30 days. A dispute not resolved in that time shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration under the LCIA Rules, which are incorporated by reference into this section, before a sole arbitrator, with the seat of arbitration in London and English as the language of the arbitration. Either party may seek urgent injunctive relief from a court.

This LOI, and any non-contractual obligation arising out of or in connection with it, is governed by the laws of Ireland. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute arising out of or in connection with this LOI by good-faith negotiation between senior executives for 30 days, after which the courts of Ireland have exclusive jurisdiction to settle it.

body.p: If any provision of this LOI is held invalid or unenforceable, it is enforced to the maximum extent permitted and the rest of this LOI continues in full force. No failure or delay in exercising a right is a waiver of it, and a waiver is effective only if it is in writing and signed. No person other than the parties and their permitted successors and assigns has any right to enforce any term of this LOI. This LOI may be signed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is an original and all of which together are one instrument.
